name: Erestor
subtitle: Chief Advisor to Elrond
game_text:
To play, spot an Elf.
<phase>Response</phase>: If an Elf is about to take a wound from a <culture>Sauron</culture> minion or <culture>Sauron</culture> event, exert Erestor to prevent that wound.
flavor_text: “‘Then there are but two courses… to hide the Ring for ever, or to unmake it.’”
